title: Marine Debris Characteristics
content: Potential marine debris may produce isolated, geometric or acoustically distinctive sonar returns.
Man-made objects can sometimes show regular shapes or strong acoustic contrasts with the surrounding seabed.
Sonar appearance alone does not prove the material composition of an object.
Sonar classification alone does not establish whether an object is hazardous.
Ambiguous detections should remain uncertain and be sent for expert verification.
